primer.title: qPCR Primer Design
primer.subtitle: Enter a gene name — validated primers in under a minute · Fully automated · Every step traceable
primer.blast_hits_scope_note: These hits come from the NCBI RefSeq RNA transcript collection. They help screen transcript-level off-target risk, but they are not equivalent to genome-wide PCR specificity validation.
primer.blast_error: RefSeq RNA BLAST is temporarily unavailable. Please try again later.
primer.blast_no_hits: No hit was found for this primer in the RefSeq RNA transcript collection.
primer.loading_msg: Querying NCBI and designing primers — this usually takes under a minute...
primer.empty_subtitle: Enter a gene name on the left to get started. The system will auto-select the best transcript, design candidates, and run BLAST validation.
primer.design_basis_intro: These values are from the actual design and screening run — use them to verify where each primer pair came from.
primer.basis_scoring_caption: Ranking combines Tm, GC%, RefSeq RNA BLAST evidence, exon-spanning behavior, and dimer risk, then returns pairs from highest to lowest score.
primer.basis_scope_note_body: A positive BLAST score here only means the primer pair shows no obvious non-target hits within the RefSeq RNA transcript collection. That improves transcript-level confidence, but it is not the same as genome-wide PCR specificity validation. Experimental use should still be backed by genome-level in-silico checks or wet-lab validation.
primer.reason_subtitle: This pair is currently ranked #{rank}. Here is how it performs across the five key dimensions.
primer.reason_no_cautions: No obvious weak link was detected. This pair ranks well because it stays balanced across dimensions.
primer.reason_tm_ideal: Both primers sit in the ideal Tm window and the pair is tightly matched.
primer.reason_tm_ok: Tm remains usable, but the pair is not as tightly matched as the best candidates.
primer.reason_tm_watch: Tm drifts from the ideal window or the pair mismatch is large enough to reduce amplification consistency.
primer.reason_gc_ideal: GC% is in the ideal band, giving a more balanced annealing profile.
primer.reason_gc_ok: GC% is still acceptable, but not in the best-performing range.
primer.reason_gc_watch: GC% is too high or too low, which can hurt annealing efficiency and specificity.
primer.reason_specificity_metric_pending: RefSeq RNA BLAST evidence is incomplete
primer.reason_specificity_validated: Within the RefSeq RNA transcript collection, both primers show no obvious non-target hits.
primer.reason_specificity_partial: RefSeq RNA BLAST evidence is incomplete, so this only counts as partial support.
primer.reason_specificity_unvalidated: RefSeq RNA BLAST failed, so this dimension cannot be treated as verified.
primer.reason_specificity_offtarget: RefSeq RNA BLAST suggests potential transcript-level non-target hits, so this dimension was penalized.
primer.reason_exon_yes: The pair spans {n} exon junction(s), which helps suppress genomic DNA interference.
primer.reason_exon_no: The pair does not span an exon junction, so it is less convincing for mRNA-focused qPCR use.
primer.reason_dimer_low: 3' self-complementarity and hairpin risk are both low, so dimer risk is limited.
primer.reason_dimer_ok: Structural risk is still below threshold, but not as clean as the strongest pairs.
primer.reason_dimer_watch: 3' self-complementarity or hairpin risk is elevated enough to potentially reduce amplification efficiency.
primer.check_blast_specific: No obvious non-target hit in RefSeq RNA
primer.check_blast_offtarget: Potential non-target hit in RefSeq RNA
primer.check_blast_unavailable: No transcript hit returned — insufficient evidence, review manually
primer.seq_placeholder: Paste target DNA sequence (200–3000 bp recommended)
primer.stopped_notice: Design stopped. You can adjust parameters and retry.
primer.stream_unavailable: The design service did not return a readable event stream.
primer.stream_incomplete: The design stream ended unexpectedly. Please retry.
primer.timeout_error: Request timed out (>3 min). NCBI servers are slow, please retry later.
primer.validate_gene_format: Gene name may only contain letters, numbers, hyphens, and underscores.
primer.validate_seq_empty: Please paste a target DNA sequence.
primer.validate_seq_short: Sequence too short — 200 bp or more is recommended for primer design.
primer.validate_seq_invalid: Sequence contains invalid characters. Please use only A, T, G, C, N.
primer.blast_warning_body: {count} primer pair(s) contain incomplete RefSeq RNA BLAST results. Review the BLAST tab before experimental use, and do not treat these results as genome-wide validation.
primer.click_hint: Click any row to expand · Switch tabs for details
primer.data_realtime_note: — Real-time query, results reflect database state at query time
primer.help_intro: From entering a gene name to receiving validated primer pairs, the system completes five steps automatically — no manual steps required.
primer.help_data_body: NCBI RefSeq (transcript sequences) · NCBI BLAST (transcript-level RefSeq RNA check) · Primer3 (primer design algorithm)
primer.help_output_body: Up to 5 screened primer pairs with Tm, GC%, RefSeq RNA BLAST evidence, exon-spanning status, and composite score (0–100)
primer.help_step_query_title: Enter a gene name or custom sequence
primer.help_step_query_body: Two modes: ① Enter a gene symbol (e.g. TP53, Actb) and the system queries NCBI automatically; ② Paste a DNA sequence directly (200–3000 bp recommended).
primer.help_step_transcript_body: Queries NCBI RefSeq in real time, filters all NM_ (protein-coding) transcripts, and selects the canonical transcript with complete CDS and the most exons as the design template.
primer.help_step_primer3_body: Runs Primer3 on the mRNA sequence to generate up to 30 candidate pairs, pre-filtered by penalty score to the best 10. Enforces Tm 58–62°C, GC% 40–60%, product size 80–200 bp.
primer.help_step_specificity_body: All 20 primer sequences (10 pairs) are submitted to NCBI BLAST against the refseq_rna database, screening for non-target transcript hits with identity > 80%. This is a transcript-level screen, not a genome-wide PCR simulation.
primer.help_step_scoring_body: Primers are ranked by a weighted composite score (max 100) across five dimensions: Tm match, GC% balance, RefSeq RNA BLAST evidence, exon-spanning design, and 3′-end self-complementarity.
primer.help_score_tm: Tm match (20 pts): both primers 58–62°C, difference < 2°C
primer.help_score_gc: GC% balance (20 pts): both primers 40–60% GC
primer.help_score_specificity: RefSeq RNA check (30 pts): top hit identity ≥ 99%, potential non-target hits ≤ 2; this does not imply genome-wide validation
primer.help_score_exon: Exon-spanning (20 pts): primers cross an intron, blocking genomic DNA amplification
primer.help_score_dimer: 3′-end dimer (10 pts): self-complementarity Tm < 35°C, hairpin Tm < 24°C
primer.help_note_body: Mature mRNA has introns spliced out, while genomic DNA retains them. Exon-spanning primers amplify only cDNA (from mRNA) and will not amplify genomic DNA, eliminating DNA contamination as a confounding factor in qPCR — this is considered best practice in qPCR experimental design.

grna.title: CRISPR gRNA Design
grna.subtitle: PAM site scanning · Activity score ranking · Heuristic risk tiers
grna.locus_help: Optional genome coordinate used to anchor the intended on-target site. The contig name should match your configured reference index.
grna.seq_placeholder: Paste target region DNA sequence (recommended 200–1000 bp)
grna.error_invalid_target_locus: Target locus must look like chr17:43044295-43044318 or chr17:43044295-43044318 (+).
grna.risk_note_body: These labels are heuristic estimates based on sequence composition, including GC content, TTTT termination motifs, and terminal base preferences. They are not a substitute for genome-wide off-target analysis before experimental use.
grna.empty_subtitle: Select a Cas protein and paste the target DNA sequence. PrimerCat will scan all PAM sites and rank candidates by predicted activity.
grna.readiness_loading_body: Checking whether the local genome-level CRISPR backend is ready for the selected species...
grna.readiness_template_body: Copy this block into backend/.env and replace the example paths with your local genome resources.
grna.readiness_copy_failed: Clipboard copy failed. Copy the block manually.
grna.readiness_step_install: 1. Install bowtie2 and make sure GRNA_BOWTIE2_PATH resolves on this machine.
grna.readiness_step_index: 2. Prepare the species-specific Bowtie2 index prefix and the matching reference FASTA.
grna.readiness_step_env: 3. Fill the env vars above, then restart the backend so genome-level screening becomes active.
grna.readiness_action_ready: The genome-level backend is already usable for the selected species.
grna.readiness_action_fallback: nt BLAST will be used as a fallback until the local genome backend is configured.
grna.readiness_action_disabled: Genome-level screening is disabled in the current configuration. This page will remain on nt BLAST.
grna.readiness_action_unavailable: The local genome backend is not currently available.
grna.readiness_action_bowtie: Install bowtie2 first, or point GRNA_BOWTIE2_PATH to a valid executable.
grna.readiness_action_env: Fill {indexVar} and {fastaVar} with the species-matched Bowtie2 index prefix and reference FASTA path.
grna.readiness_action_anchor: Target-locus anchoring will stay unavailable until genome-level screening is ready.
grna.readiness_anchor_note: A target locus is filled in, but it will not be used until the genome-level backend is ready.
grna.scope_hint: Prefers local genome screening, otherwise nt BLAST fallback
grna.error_short_sequence: Target sequence is too short. At least 23 bp is required.
grna.feature_activity_title: Activity scores are heuristic estimates, not experimental predictions
grna.feature_activity_body: SpCas9 / SpCas9-NG and Cas12a are scored separately. The interface explicitly shows heuristic tiers so you know this is a first-pass ranking, not a final experimental verdict.
grna.feature_offtarget_title: Off-target screening with explicit status reporting
grna.feature_offtarget_body: Each guide is labeled as validated, no_hits, anchor_missing, error, or skipped. When a local genome index is configured, screening is genome-level; otherwise the fallback is labeled explicitly on the result page.
grna.feature_evidence_body: Expanded rows show guide+PAM, best non-target identity, and the top genomic hits so users can audit the recommendation.
grna.results_intro: Returned {count} {cas} candidates. Off-target screening was limited to {species}-filtered nt records.
grna.results_intro_genome: Returned {count} {cas} candidates. Genome-level screening was run against the configured {species} reference genome.
grna.results_intro_fallback: Returned {count} {cas} candidates. Genome-level screening was not available, so the result fell back to {species}-filtered nt BLAST.
grna.fallback_body: This run did not use the local genome index. The result below is still usable as a transcript-level screen, but it should not be read as a completed genome-wide off-target analysis.
grna.activity_model_body: The activity score is still a sequence-feature heuristic. It helps surface stronger candidates first, but it should not be treated as an experimental success rate.
grna.offtarget_model_body: When a local Bowtie2 genome index is configured, the system screens the guide against the species reference genome. If that backend is unavailable, it falls back to species-filtered nt BLAST and labels the run accordingly.
grna.scope_body: When the genome backend is active this scope is the configured species reference genome. Otherwise it is a fallback transcript- or record-level nt screen, which is weaker evidence than a full genome pass.
grna.offtarget_summary_clean: Only one high-confidence genomic hit was detected, so it is treated as the intended locus.
grna.offtarget_summary_hits: {count} additional high-confidence genomic hit(s) were detected.
grna.offtarget_summary_anchor_missing: The provided target locus did not match any returned genome hit for this guide.
grna.offtarget_summary_no_hits: No high-confidence genomic hit was found, so supporting evidence is limited.
grna.offtarget_summary_error: The off-target screen failed, so this candidate should not be treated as validated.
grna.offtarget_summary_skipped: No off-target screen was available for the selected species.
grna.activity_panel_body: Final ranking is still affected by the off-target layer, so a high activity score does not automatically mean rank #1.
grna.hit_annotation_ready_body: The genomic hits below were annotated against the configured species gene model, so you can inspect nearby genes and transcript context.
grna.hit_annotation_missing_body: Genome-level hits were found, but no species gene model is configured yet, so gene / exon / promoter labels are still unavailable.
grna.hit_annotation_fallback_body: This run did not produce genome-coordinate hits, so gene-context labels were not attached to the top hits below.
grna.hit_annotation_unavailable_inline: No gene-model annotation was attached to this hit.
grna.scope_note: Treat this panel according to the active backend. If genome-level screening is enabled, these hits come from the configured reference genome. If the run fell back, the evidence below is weaker than a full genome-wide CRISPR off-target assessment.
